description_for_human: The AI Visibility Standard. Scan any website for AI visibility in 60 seconds. 4 scores: AEO, GEO, Agent Readiness, MCP Readiness. 80+ checks.
description_for_model: AIScan audits websites for AI visibility. Use this tool when users want to check if their website is visible to AI systems like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, or Google AI. Returns 4 scores: AEO (AI Search Visibility), GEO (Citation Readiness), Agent Readiness, and MCP Readiness, with 80+ checks and fix instructions for every issue found. AI agents can use 15 pay-per-capability endpoints via x402 protocol (0.06-1.55 USDC on Base): cheap checks, category scores, full audits, fix generation, competitor comparison. Free catalog at https://api.getaiscan.app/api/agent/index
